strings.تقدر تجدّد ديكور الشاشة وتحتفظ بالكنب وا: You can renew the decor of the screen and keep the sofa and floor if you start with the colors already in your lounge. Choosing the background alone from an image may give you a beautiful wall, but it is what fits into the rest of the place. The solution is to compare the finishing sample with the furniture and in the lighting of the house before adopting the implementation.

This way the design starts from your current home, and the scope of the work is clear from the beginning.

strings.صوّر الأرضية والكنب والستائر والباب القر: Picture the floor, sofa, curtains and door close to the screen, and take a general picture without color effects. Choose a fixed element that is a reference for formatting; such as what floor you intend to switch. Then compare a quiet background with it before adding veins, a second color or a prominent frame.
strings.إذا الأثاث فيه نقوش كثيرة، جرّب خلفية أق: If the furniture has many inscriptions, try a less visually crowded background. If the lounge is quiet, a specific space can be allocated to a striking detail. These are design options and not rules that bind every house, so comparing the sample and the scheme is more important than describing the color as "luxury" only.
strings.العينة داخل البيت أهم من شاشة الجوال: The sample inside the house is more important than the mobile screen.
strings.حط العينة قرب الأرضية والباب في موقع الج: Land the sample near the floor and door at the location of the proposed wall, and review it during the day and under the lighting you use in the evening. See the direction of the veins and the brightness of the surface and the confluence of color with the existing cabinet. Two images of the same material may differ due to lighting and photography, so the image of the catalog alone does not make your final adoption.
